note: Busy NGPC SRA near Waterloo set among seven sandpit lakes (320 acres of water) and the Platte River, with a put-and-take trout lake, a swim beach and 10 caboose cabins. Seven camping areas; Cottonwood's west row backs onto the Platte, Lakeside's east row faces the lake. --Claude
summary: RA page and all 102 reservable sites read: 74 Electric Plus (50 A), 6 Full Hookup (Fawn Meadows), 22 Basic (Riverside); 209 padded sites per the park text, all paved; booking (RA, 180 days, Apr 15-Sep 30), hookups, sites, showers/dump now manual. Quotes $30 EP / $35 full / $15 basic match the grid. Pin is off every loop (237 m+). Split candidate: Lakeside + Fawn Meadows ~1.2-1.7 km south of the northern loops. Waterfront: suggest lakefront -> riverfront (Cottonwood west row on the Platte bank).
flags: PIN OFF-LOOP: stored 41.22233,-96.35659 is at the office/entrance area beside the west lake, not on a camping loop: 237 m from Riverside's centre, 492-581 m from Goldenrod/Oak Grove/Cottonwood, 1.0-1.2 km from Lakeside/Fawn Meadows. Suggest Cottonwood's centre 41.22742,-96.35815 (largest electric loop, 23 reservable EP sites) or Goldenrod 41.22579,-96.35292 if the entry stays whole; if split, see below.

SPLIT CANDIDATE: loop centres from RA GIS: Cottonwood 41.22742,-96.35815 (23 reservable EP, 50 A); Oak Grove 41.22672,-96.35498 (8 EP); Goldenrod 41.22579,-96.35292 (25 EP); Riverside 41.22022,-96.35695 (22 Basic, back-in to 77 ft); Lakeside 41.21406,-96.34787 (18 EP); Fawn Meadows 41.21554,-96.34934 (6 Full Hookup). The north group (Cottonwood/Oak Grove/Goldenrod, 200-470 m apart) and Riverside (700-800 m S) are reached from the park road by the office; Lakeside + Fawn Meadows (206 m apart) lie 1.2-1.7 km SE of the north group, south of the east-west road, reached by their own spur off it ~190 m east of the main park road's junction (imagery; whether that road is public I could not confirm). Counts above are the RA-reservable half only.

WATERFRONT (suggest lakefront -> riverfront): Cottonwood's west row (sites 154, 156, 158, 160, 162, 164; Electric Plus, paved) sits on the Platte's east bank: NAIP 2026-11-05 puts the site points ~6-12 m from the water across a bank with scattered cottonwoods and gaps, the loop road behind (east of) the sites, no driveway or day use between; the Platte is ~300 m wide (river). Lakeside's east row (012, 014, 016, 018) is ~15-25 m from a ~6.5-acre lake (NAIP NIR fill, over the 5-acre line) but a gravel shore path and a tree belt run between - lakeview at best. Goldenrod 057/058, the only sites RA tags 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' (all others 'Near Water - no'), face the swim-beach lake, which fills to only ~3.2 acres on NAIP (under 5 acres = pond, no view value) with the loop road between - no value. West lake by the office ~8.3 acres, no sites on it. If AWH judges Cottonwood's bank trees a screen, the entry goes to lakeview/riverview.
SAND RULE: every reservable site's Driveway Surface is 'Paved' (Cottonwood, Fawn Meadows, Lakeside, Oak Grove, Riverside); Goldenrod's pages give no surface. Not a candidate.

FEES CONFIRMED / ONE ODDITY: RA quotes $30 Electric Plus (site 122), $35 Full Hookup (038), $15 Basic (171) a night for 5/2/2027, matching the grid; but 4/18/2027 quotes the same in-season figures, not the grid's '$5 less mid-October through April'. Stored fees (grid-sourced, nightly_low 10) left alone; worth one more check before trusting the off-season low.
